requirements: All ten templates validate and generate deterministic group records.
Every generated group contains between its template minimum and maximum member count.
Minimum and maximum requested sizes are both generated for every template.
Every member embeds a canonical NPC profile with a unique profile ID and full name.
Every member references the shared organization and location.
The leader exists, the optional second exists when its role is allocated, and every nonleader reports to an existing member.
Every relationship endpoint resolves and every directed edge has a reciprocal edge with inverse types.
Members whose role requires the shared surname use the group surname.
Every profile contains a groupMembership extension and preserves group and template provenance.
All ten group kinds have distinct role structures and shared context.
Malformed template references and impossible capacities produce actionable diagnostics before generation.
